summaryZh: Komor Lab 研究人类遗传变异的功能及精准基因组编辑技术。方向包括 DNA 损伤修复基因突变、非传统编辑工具的机制和新编辑方法，结合化学生物学与基因组编辑。
researchQuestions: DNA 修复基因突变如何影响酶活性、细胞功能及人类健康？
现有碱基编辑酶如何发挥功能？
细胞如何处理碱基编辑器和先导编辑器产生的中间体？

evidence.quote: The Komor Lab Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry at the University of California, San Diego
Functional investigation of human genetic variation and development of precision genome editing methodologies using chemical biology
Functional investigation of mutations in DNA damage repair genes
Mechanistic study of "nontraditional" genome editing tools

We have therefore initiated a research program aimed at developing new laboratory-based strategies and systems to study how mutations in DNA repair genes (our area of expertise) affect enzymatic activity, cellular function, and ultimately human health.
A second major research focus of the Komor Lab aims to mechanistically understand how current BE enzymes function.

In contrast, the cellular processing mechanisms of “nontraditional” genome editing intermediates are largely unknown, and a third research focus of the Komor Lab is to mechanistically study how base editor and prime editor intermediates are processed by the cell.
